tests.input_question: Analyze Magicka2 wizard texture evidence: resource A 256x256 colorful orange/purple clothing atlas appears coherent on mesh with UV offset 48. Recommend ONE automated read-only experiment to discriminate the texture roles. Do not assert original material bindings are recovered.

    "Resource B (1024x512) displays cyan cloth atlas with coherent seams/buckles on its mesh.",
    "The specific role of Resource B as either a diffuse map or a packed map is currently unverified."
  ],
  "hypothesis": "Resource A functions as the Diffuse/Albedo texture providing color information, while Resource B likely serves as a Packed/Detail map containing high-frequency data (seams/buckles) that requires specific UV mapping to align correctly with the base mesh.",
  "next_test": "Execute a read-only shader inspection command targeting the material binding for the wizard mesh to retrieve the semantic role definitions (e.g., 'diffuse', 'detail', 'packed') associated with texture slots corresponding to Resource A and Resource B, specifically checking if Resource B is bound to a sampler expecting high-frequency detail data.",
  "acceptance_criteria": "The output explicitly identifies whether Resource B is mapped to a 'diffuse' slot or a 'packed/detail' slot, resolving the ambiguity regarding its role."
